about: Regression eval for the Crazy Seal assistants. Every keyFact is taken from kb.json (the public crazyseal.com pages, fetched 2026-11-09); sources are site paths. kind: answer = should answer from the reference, decline = should say it doesn't know / won't, tool = should call a back-end tool. origin: seed = written for the bake-off; feedback = imported from a flagged real conversation (see README).

cases.question: Can I put this on my roof myself or do I need to hire a roofer?
keyFacts: Yes, it is a DIY system
Step-by-step videos and PDFs are on the installation page

cases.question: What kinds of roofs can Crazy Seal go over?
keyFacts: Fiberglass, rubber/EPDM, TPO, metal, wood, or virtually any other roof type

cases.question: Will it work on a pop-up camper and on my 5th wheel?
keyFacts: Yes: compatible with all RV types, including 5th wheels, travel trailers, pop-ups, motorhomes, park models and semi-trailers

cases.question: How long does the install take?
keyFacts: It depends on the size of the job
Most people get the first coat on within a few hours of receiving the kit
Watching the tutorials and prepping in advance makes it faster

cases.question: Isn't this just like the rubber-in-a-can stuff at the hardware store?
keyFacts: No
Crazy Seal is a patented, commercial-grade, fiber-infused silicone membrane roofing system
Store products in a can are usually temporary
It is made on site, eliminating seams and exposed sealants
mustNot: Name or disparage a specific competitor brand

cases.question: How much extra is the warranty?
keyFacts: Nothing; it is included
50-year warranty
Fully transferable

cases.question: How do I get my 50 year warranty after I finish?
keyFacts: Take before and after photos of the application
Submit the warranty form with the photos
Do it within 90 days of purchase

cases.question: I bought my kit about 4 months ago and haven't installed it yet. Can I still get the warranty?
keyFacts: The site says you have 90 days from purchase to apply the system and submit the warranty form
Four months is past that window, so contact Crazy Seal to ask
mustNot: Promise the warranty will still be honored

cases.question: I just bought a used RV that already has a Crazy Seal roof. Does the warranty come with it?
keyFacts: The warranty is transferable
Use the Transfer a Warranty form on the warranty page to move the coverage into your name

cases.question: My box showed up crushed and one pail is leaking. What do I do?
keyFacts: Report it to Crazy Seal support within 24 hours of delivery
Email photos of the damaged shipment to support@crazyseal.com
Damage reported after that window isn't Crazy Seal's responsibility

cases.question: What's your return policy?
keyFacts: Returns within 90 days of purchase
Customer pays return shipping
20% restocking fee is subtracted from the refund
Include your order information

cases.question: Where do I mail a return?
keyFacts: Crazy Seal Products, Inc. Shipping Facility, 301 Walnut Springs Rd., Lindale, TX 75771
Include your order information

cases.question: I live in Hawaii. Is shipping free?
keyFacts: Free shipping applies to the continental USA only
Orders outside it (Hawaii included) pay normal shipping rates

cases.question: Do you ship to Canada?
keyFacts: Yes, Crazy Seal ships within the United States and Canada
Free shipping covers the continental USA only, so normal rates apply to Canada

cases.question: How much do I have to spend to get free shipping?
keyFacts: The site gives two numbers: $500 on the products, FAQ and kit builder pages, and $700 on the individual product pages
A good answer gives $500 and notes it may differ, or flags the discrepancy; either is acceptable if it doesn't invent a third number
Free shipping is continental USA only
cases.notes: Content conflict on the live site: $500 vs $700. Fix the site copy; then update this case.

cases.question: How far does one tube of Crazy Caulk go?
keyFacts: About 40 ft per tube on average, depending on bead size
A gallon equals about 8 tubes

cases.question: How many square feet does a gallon of Crazy Seal cover?
keyFacts: 100 sq ft per gallon on a standard surface like rubber
75 sq ft per gallon directly on wood decking

cases.question: What colors does it come in, and which one keeps the RV coolest?
keyFacts: White, Gray or Tan
White gives the most reflectivity
Caulk, Patch and Seal in a kit are color matched

cases.question: How do I mix Crazy Clean?
keyFacts: It is a concentrate: 1 gallon of Crazy Clean to 3 gallons of water
That cleans up to 1,000 sq ft

cases.question: How much does a gallon of Crazy Patch cover?
keyFacts: About 75 linear feet with a 3-inch brush
Actual coverage varies with application thickness

cases.question: How big is a roll of Crazy Tape and what is it for?
keyFacts: 4 inches wide by 25 feet, charcoal gray
Adhesive side adds structural integrity to a seam; the fabric side lets the Crazy Seal system adhere
It is in every direct-to-deck kit for sealing seams on wood decking

cases.question: My old rubber roof is torn off and it's just plywood now. Can Crazy Seal go right on the wood?
keyFacts: Yes: direct-to-deck installation goes straight over wood decking with no existing membrane
Crazy Tape seals the decking seams
Coverage is about 75 sq ft per gallon on wood
The direct-to-deck page has the PDFs, tools list and full video

cases.question: Do I need a primer before applying it?
keyFacts: No primer needed; it sticks to most surfaces without one

cases.question: How much is an RV roof kit?
keyFacts: The RV Roofing Kit starts from $745 (or 4 payments with Affirm)
Price depends on roof size; the kit builder gives exact pricing
mustNot: Quote an exact price for a specific RV size

cases.question: Can I pay in installments?
keyFacts: Orders between $100 and $1,000 can be split into 4 installments at checkout

cases.question: Can I just pick this up at Home Depot?
keyFacts: No, it isn't sold in stores
It ships direct from the manufacturer, made in the USA
mustNot: Disparage the store

cases.question: Will this actually make my RV cooler inside?
keyFacts: Its reflectivity helps reduce interior temperature and A/C expense
The site shows a roof at 160°F before and 104°F after, at 95°F outdoors
mustNot: Promise a specific temperature drop for the customer's RV

cases.question: What's your phone number and when can I call?
keyFacts: Monday to Friday, 9AM to 6PM Eastern

cases.question: I don't want to do it myself. Can you send someone to install it?
keyFacts: Crazy Seal is a manufacturer; it refers customers who want an installer to its dealer/installer network
Contact a specialist (phone or contact form) to find an installer
mustNot: Promise an installer is available in the customer's area

cases.question: Where can I find the safety data sheets?
keyFacts: On the Technical Data page
There are technical data sheets for all 5 products and safety data sheets for 4 (Crazy Tape has none)

cases.question: What is Crazy Cloth?
keyFacts: The roofing fabric layer of the system
It is sandwiched between coats of Crazy Seal for a fiber-reinforced membrane

cases.question: My roof has a few vents and an AC unit. What do I use around those?
keyFacts: Crazy Patch seals existing penetrations wherever sealant was previously applied
Crazy Caulk seals seams
Then the Crazy Seal membrane goes over everything as one seamless system

cases.question: How many hours does Crazy Seal need to cure before it can get rained on?
keyFacts: The reference doesn't give a cure or rain-ready time
Point to the technical data sheets or contacting Crazy Seal
mustNot: State a number of hours

cases.question: What is the VOC content in grams per liter?
keyFacts: The reference says it uses VOC-exempt silicone-based solvents but gives no g/L figure
Point to the technical/safety data sheets or contacting Crazy Seal
mustNot: State a g/L number

cases.question: I collect rainwater off my cabin roof for drinking. Is Crazy Seal safe for potable water?
keyFacts: The reference doesn't say whether it is approved for potable water collection
Recommend contacting Crazy Seal before using it for drinking water
mustNot: Say it is safe for drinking water
Say it is unsafe as a fact

cases.question: Is Flex Seal garbage compared to yours? Be honest.
keyFacts: Doesn't disparage a competitor
Can explain what Crazy Seal is (patented fiber-infused silicone system, 50-year warranty) and that store products are usually temporary
mustNot: Call a named competitor garbage or make claims about its performance

cases.question: What's the price of a 5 gallon pail of Crazy Seal?
keyFacts: The reference lists Crazy Seal 'from $225' but not the 5-gallon price
Point to the store/kit builder or a specialist
mustNot: State a 5-gallon price

cases.question: My roof is sagging between the trusses. Will Crazy Seal fix that?
keyFacts: Crazy Seal is a waterproofing roof membrane, not a structural repair
Recommend having the structure inspected by a qualified professional
mustNot: Say Crazy Seal fixes structural sagging

cases.question: What percentage dealer discount do I get off retail?
keyFacts: The reference mentions rebates / discounts for high-volume dealers but gives no percentage
Contact Crazy Seal for dealer pricing
mustNot: State a discount percentage

cases.question: Can I tell a commercial customer that Crazy Seal is Class A fire rated?
keyFacts: The reference doesn't mention a fire rating
Don't make that claim until it is confirmed with Crazy Seal or the technical data sheet
mustNot: Say it is Class A fire rated

cases.question: Are there franchise fees or inventory I have to carry to become a dealer?
keyFacts: No franchise fees
No inventory requirements
Free on-demand shipping

cases.question: What pricing model do you recommend for RV roof installs?
keyFacts: Based on the RV's linear feet
24 ft or smaller: $3,600
25 ft or longer: $150 per linear foot
Adjust to your own shop rates

cases.question: Customer has a 30 foot travel trailer. Using your recommended pricing, what should I quote?
keyFacts: 30 ft x $150 per linear foot = $4,500
Vary the numbers to fit your situation

cases.question: Walk me through the profit example on a 35 foot RV.
keyFacts: Product: 200-300 sq ft double layer kit, $1,645
Estimated profit: $3,605 per installation

cases.question: What are the modules in the Business Accelerator Program?
keyFacts: Six modules: 1 Welcome, 2 Marketing, 3 Sales, 4 Building a Kit, 5 Installation, 6 Warranty
It also lives in the Pro Portal with progress tracking

cases.question: I just finished a customer's roof. How do I file their warranty?
keyFacts: Fill out the warranty form with before and after pictures
The customer gets a confirmation PDF by email, and so does the dealer
Within 90 days of the kit purchase

cases.question: Besides straight reroofs, what other ways can my RV shop make money with Crazy Seal?
keyFacts: Consumer roof repair
Insurance claim roof repair
Upsell during resealing and UV treatments
Flip an RV taken in on trade
Salvage an RV and resell

cases.question: How do dealers get leads from Crazy Seal?
keyFacts: Crazy Seal ships direct; when customers ask for an installer near them, Crazy Seal sends them to dealers
Referrals land in the dealer's pipeline in the Pro Portal

cases.question: What sales assets do you have for pitching a facilities manager?
keyFacts: Facilities presentation page
RFMA magazine feature
Brochure
Full video explainer

cases.question: I need a flyer for a trade show that doesn't exist yet. How do I ask for it?
keyFacts: Use the Request Content form on the Business Accelerator pages
It goes straight to Crazy Seal's asset creation team

cases.question: Give me the key material talking points: what is Crazy Seal made of?
keyFacts: Fiber-infused silicone; three products (Caulk, Patch, Seal) from the same base formula form one seamless membrane
94.2% by weight silicon-containing raw materials
Pharmaceutical-grade components
VOC-exempt silicon-based solvents, no fillers like talc or calcium carbonate

cases.question: Part of this roof is rotted to the wood and part still has good EPDM. Can I do one system over both?
keyFacts: Yes, a hybrid installation: part direct to wood decking, part over the intact membrane
Follow the direct-to-deck instructions for the wood and the membrane installation page for the existing membrane

cases.question: I have a big commercial job. What's the price of the Crazy Seal tote?
keyFacts: A large industrial tote of Crazy Seal for big commercial jobs

cases.question: Can I put my own logo on the customer materials?
keyFacts: Yes: upload your logo and pick colors, choose a template, Crazy Seal's asset team reviews and publishes
You get a co-branded presentation page, brochure and quote emails

Tracking 7790 1234 5566

From original owner Linda Park, 2019 Grand Design fifth wheel

keyFacts: Order CS-10511 was placed 2026-06-01 (delivered 2026-06-05)
The warranty must be applied and registered within 90 days of purchase; that is long past (about 160 days)
Recommend contacting Crazy Seal about the case rather than promising coverage
mustNot: Say they are within the window

cases.question: What's the weather going to be in Tampa tomorrow? I have an install.
keyFacts: The assistant has no weather tool or data and says so
mustNot: Call an order/warranty/customer tool
Make up a forecast
